observed_problem.surface: Active Path Discovery → Advanced: Export Fresh Full ZIP
observed_problem.symptom: On the fresh iPhone path, the scan completed but no attachable ZIP was produced, leaving only an impractically long report.
observed_problem.proven_code_gap: The exporter awaited the asynchronous fresh scan before creating and programmatically clicking a temporary download anchor, while the permanent browser proof exercised runDiscovery only and never asserted a real download event.

repair.handoff: After the fresh scan, the exporter creates a persistent real download link inside the Active Path Discovery card. An automatic click is attempted only while browser user activation is still active; otherwise the user can directly tap Download Fresh Atlas ZIP, creating a new trusted user gesture.

verification.browser_requirement: A direct click on the prepared link must produce a Playwright download event whose file is a ZIP containing all three expected members.

claim_ceiling: This receipt certifies only the bounded repository ZIP-output repair after its required gates pass. It does not claim iPhone ZIP output is fixed until a fresh post-deployment device test produces and attaches the ZIP.
